title: SonicWALL NSv setSshdConfig Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of SonicWALL NSv. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system or send a TCP packet to a local service in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the setSshdConfig command. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
